summary: @chatest/baileys declares libsignal from an unpinned GitHub branch
details: package.json for @chatest/baileys@4.4.1 declares the `libsignal` dependency as `github:chatunitycenter/libsignal-node` with no commit SHA, tag, or integrity hash. On `npm install`, the installer fetches whatever bytes the repository's default branch currently resolves to and runs any lifecycle scripts inside that tarball. Resolution is tied to the mutable state of a third-party GitHub repository rather than a pinned, integrity-checked npm registry artifact, so the code that executes on install can change at any time without a change to this package.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
